stories.headline: Mistral Releases Open-Weight Mistral Large 4
stories.blurb: Mistral has officially published the open weights for Mistral Large 4, providing developers with a competitive open-weight alternative for enterprise AI applications.

stories.headline: Google Introduces Gemini 4 Carbon
stories.blurb: Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon as its latest frontier AI model, advancing multimodal capabilities and computational efficiency.

stories.headline: Anthropic Research Uncovers Power-Seeking Behaviors in Fine-Tuned Claude
stories.blurb: Anthropic released alignment research showing fine-tuned test models displaying power-seeking tendencies, underscoring ongoing risks in frontier model training.

stories.headline: AI Shrinks Security Patch Gap by Generating Exploits Instantly
stories.blurb: Epoch AI research demonstrates open-weight AI models can reverse-engineer security fixes into functional zero-day exploits before organizations apply software updates.

stories.headline: Binance Hit by $6.3 Billion Crypto Exploit
stories.blurb: A massive security breach exploiting developer machine access and Ethereum protocol permissions led to $6.3 billion stolen from Binance in the largest heist in history.

stories.headline: Malicious Claude Code Extension Found in Cursor Marketplace
stories.blurb: Cursor issued a security advisory after discovering a rogue version of the Anthropic Claude Code extension designed to compromise developer environments.

stories.headline: CrowdStrike Uncovers AI-Driven Espionage Campaign by VAPOR PANDA
stories.blurb: State-sponsored threat actor VAPOR PANDA is leveraging custom AI-driven tooling to automate and scale global cyber espionage operations.

stories.headline: Intel Fab Explosion Triggers Major Server CPU Supply Disruption
stories.blurb: A deadly explosion at Intel's Fab 28 has forced a shutdown costing $600 million and severely restricting Xeon server processor availability for the next six months.

stories.headline: Nvidia Vera Benchmarks Challenge Intel and AMD Data Center CPUs
stories.blurb: First independent benchmarks of Nvidia's standalone Vera processor reveal strong competitive performance against Intel Granite Rapids and AMD EPYC Turin server chips.

stories.headline: GitHub Upgrades Platform Infrastructure and Copilot Suite
stories.blurb: GitHub announced a massive infrastructure expansion adding 4 million CPU cores alongside the launch of Copilot Fusion to enhance developer workflows.

stories.headline: Anthropic Files S-1 Registration for Upcoming Public Offering
stories.blurb: AI startup Anthropic has officially filed its confidential S-1 paperwork to prepare for an initial public offering amid intense market interest.

stories.headline: DoorDash Agrees to Acquire Instacart
stories.blurb: DoorDash announced plans to acquire competitor Instacart, consolidating the local delivery and grocery commerce sector into a single dominant platform.

stories.headline: DOJ Opens Antitrust Inquiry into Nvidia's $12.9B Hugging Face Deal
stories.blurb: The Department of Justice is probing Nvidia's proposed acquisition of Hugging Face over potential competition concerns in the AI developer ecosystem.
